title: OrigoZero
desc: An AI game maker for 3D games in the browser: describe your idea, an agent builds it live in the Zero engine, then publish it on OrigoZero for anyone to play.

title: mindblown
desc: Describe a game and mindblown's AI game maker builds it, playtests it and puts it online. Change it by chatting, or play free browser games others made.

title: OmGithub
desc: Discover and play games, and explore their creators and source on GitHub; also lets you make games.

title: Astrocade
desc: The social gaming platform where anyone can build, share, and play AI games. No coding or downloads.

title: Bitmagic
desc: AI-first game development: new games from new creators every day, one tap, in your browser, free.

title: Rosebud AI
desc: Create playable games with AI prompts. Describe your idea or choose a template, then build and deploy your game. No coding required.

title: Spawn
desc: Your place to make games with friends: describe anything and Savi, your AI game builder, makes it with you. Then play together instantly in your browser.

title: Upit
desc: AI game creator: create, play and share games with Upit.

title: Jabali
desc: Create your own game instantly with Jabali's AI game generator: puzzle, shooter, anime games and more with no code, playable in minutes.

title: Makko AI
desc: Make 2D games with AI: start with concept art, then create characters, backgrounds, objects and animations in one consistent style, and build playable games in your browser.

title: Ludo.ai
desc: Production-ready game assets (sprites, icons, UI, textures, music, 3D and video) generated by AI, ready to drop into your engine.

title: Scenario
desc: The leading AI models in one place for creative production and game assets. Build image, video, 3D and audio pipelines with workflows and agents.

title: Layer
desc: Generate images, video, 3D and audio with 300+ models, train Layer on your style, and automate production.

title: God Mode AI
desc: AI sprite & animation generator for games: artifact-free looping animations, rich action types, multiple camera views and advanced VFX. Commercial licensing included.

title: Meshy
desc: Turns text and images into production-ready 3D models in 20-30 seconds. Export to FBX, OBJ, GLB and STL.

title: Bezi
desc: The AI assistant built for Unity developers: debugging, code generation, shader creation and prototyping, working with your actual project.

title: FLUX 3 Image Klein
desc: 5.6B open weights model for text-to-image generation and image editing: a prompt plus up to 10 reference images in, one image out. FLUX Kommunity License (non-commercial, with a commercial-output exception for qualifying users).

title: Krea 3 Image Edit
desc: Krea 3 is an image editing model built for production: it changes only what you ask, with up to 6 reference images and 1K or 2K output. Available in Krea's app and API; no downloadable weights published.
